items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: Aunt Louise, is that her name? She used to be a snake dancer or something in some little club?

ctx.x: Well, you've done so many beautiful things. And Redd Foxx is a wonderful, powerful man. Throughout the whole black community we have such respect for him for when he finally made it and got to be a star, he went back and pulled out all the old entertainers. Just so beautiful.
Yeah, I know. Aunt Louise, is that her name? She used to be a snake dancer or something in some little club? He's got all his old buddies there.
He put them all out and (inaudible).
